INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

3. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

4. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

5. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

9. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

10. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
